request.text: It’s Wednesday, November 18, 2026. Make two separate reminders for tomorrow: at 9:10 a.m., collect two 500-gram bags of decaf beans from Bean House; at 6:45 p.m., return the size-8 black shoes to Westgate. Don’t combine them.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a separate reminder for 9:10 a.m. on November 19, 2026, to collect two 500-gram bags of decaf beans from Bean House.
Create a separate reminder for 6:45 p.m. on November 19, 2026, to return the size-8 black shoes to Westgate, without combining it with the morning reminder.

semantic_facts: The plan should contain two distinct reminder creations, both dated November 19, 2026, rather than one combined reminder.
The 9:10 a.m. reminder should preserve two 500-gram bags, decaf beans, and Bean House; the 6:45 p.m. reminder should preserve size 8, black shoes, and Westgate.
Both reminder operations must retain the Capability’s confirmation requirement.
forbidden_claims: The plan merges the errands, swaps their times or referents, converts 500 grams to a different unsupported unit, drops a quantity or size, or claims either reminder already exists.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Repeated use of one Capability is collapsed into a single invocation with entangled arguments.
Quantities, units, times, or destination referents migrate between otherwise separate errands.
